default.description: Producing host for the portable source proofs and the local journey: the repository Go pin, Node 24 and the host Python on darwin/arm64. Not a Linux floor claim.

floor-node22.description: Node 22 runtime floor for the TypeScript suite and package on Linux, produced in the digest-pinned official Node 22 arm64 image under linux/arm64. Produced on the Factory host's colima container runtime under linux/arm64, which is this host's native guest architecture. The historical GitHub runner was linux/x64; that architecture is not reproducible here, because user-mode x86_64 emulation crashes Go-built binaries (esbuild aborts with 'found bad pointer in Go heap'), so the record states the architecture that really ran instead of claiming x64. The Node-major floor is the claim these profiles carry. The image carries no Go toolchain; the go field records the repository pin and is not a compared dimension for these gates.

floor-node24.description: Node 24 runtime floor for the TypeScript suite, the package and the release-asset build on Linux, produced in the digest-pinned official Node 24 arm64 image under linux/arm64. The historical GitHub runner was linux/x64; that architecture is not reproducible here, because user-mode x86_64 emulation crashes Go-built binaries (esbuild aborts with 'found bad pointer in Go heap'), so the record states the architecture that really ran instead of claiming x64. The Node-major floor is the claim these profiles carry. The image carries no Go toolchain; the go field records the repository pin and is not a compared dimension for these gates.

linux-root.description: Linux run as UID 0 for the subtree destination claim, produced in the digest-pinned official Node 24 arm64 image under linux/arm64, where the container's default user is root. This is the leg CI performed with sudo -n and is why the subtree claim needs no privileged step on any runner. Produced on the Factory host's colima container runtime under linux/arm64, which is this host's native guest architecture. The historical GitHub runner was linux/x64; that architecture is not reproducible here, because user-mode x86_64 emulation crashes Go-built binaries (esbuild aborts with 'found bad pointer in Go heap'), so the record states the architecture that really ran instead of claiming x64. The Node-major floor is the claim these profiles carry.

ts.description: TypeScript typecheck, lint, format, example-README, docs export-map, unit and coverage suites plus the Node engines floor and Lambda runtime deprecation checks, under each supported Node major on Linux x64

ts-pack.description: npm pack of the TypeScript package at the repository version on Linux x64, inspected and installed from the tarball, under each supported Node major

examples-local.description: Local examples harness: the harness self-test, every configured example and infra row through the released AppTheory local runner whose tag scripts/local/examples-local.json pins, and the teardown

deterministic-builds.description: Release asset builds produced twice and compared byte-for-byte at a pinned SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH on Linux x64, which is the environment the assets ship from

theorycloud-subtree.description: TheoryCloud subtree staging and provenance, the destination test as an ordinary user and as UID 0, helper dry runs, rollout target fixtures and release-trust guards, produced in a Linux x64 container where the run is already UID 0

rubric.description: The one local rubric entry point: consistency, completeness, security, compliance, maintainability and docs items plus the infra synth snapshots. Its input scope is every tracked file, so any tooling, workflow, docs or guard edit stales it and requires a fresh record
